message: symfony/flex is a Composer plugin, whose code runs during Composer commands, and "symfony/*" in config.allow-plugins in composer.json lets Composer run it, but depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Review the plugin and add composer:symfony/flex to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json, or put "symfony/flex": false before "symfony/*" in config.allow-plugins of composer.json, because Composer takes the first key that matches

message: phpstan/extension-installer is a Composer plugin that config.allow-plugins in composer.json does not list, so Composer asks whether to run it, and a run without a terminal (CI) fails; depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Review the plugin: add composer:phpstan/extension-installer to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json if the project needs it, or to installScripts.deny if it works without it, then run depcurfew apply
